findings: The released GPT-NeoX pondering path explicitly calls full-vocabulary interpolation(use_topk=False),although a top100 implementation also exists. Do not infer that our full expectation is a missing top-k bug.
Optional embedding scaling multiplies both source embeddings and workspace value rows by sqrt(hidden_size). The released README demo enables it;our registered model does not.

The reference initializer has depth/ponder-budget-dependent output projection scaling. Our initializer uses the already-qualified unique-depth scaling. These are recipe differences,not proven explanations of a failed screen.
decision: Keep the active joint-exit registration unchanged. Any new recipe ablation would require its own ordinary control and measured cost. Do not import several reference options together and attribute their effect to thinking.
